utterances.text: This person is also registered as living at Taubergasse 15, door 14, since 11th January 1995?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If you turn the page, still in the German version, the fourth name down is Sanda Mucic born 27th April 1979, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: She is registered as living at Taubergasse 15, door 10; is that right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You know she is the daughter of Zdravko Mucic?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I do know that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: She is the same Sanda Mucic who was present at apartment 10 after the arrest of Mr. Mucic.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I suppose that it is, I only know one Sanda Mucic.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you also confirm that on the day of the alleged search and seizure at Taubergasse 15, Hariso Delalic was present?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: She was there, Mr. Moerbaur gave her a key to the apartment.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You know she is the sister-in-law of Zejnil Delalic?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I know Hariso Delalic, it is the widow of the Sefik Delalic who died. This is what Mr. Moerbaur told me.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The deceased is the brother of Mr. Delalic which makes Hariso his sister-in-law, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, one of the six or seven Delalic brothers, right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Also present on 18th March was Dzemal Delalic, present at Taubergasse 15, who is the brother of Zejnil Delalic.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If I could direct your attention to page 3 of the same document, D62/1, looking at the top of that page, it is headed "former registrations for Taubergasse 15"; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is the list of people who were registered as living at Taubergasse 15 but who no longer live there, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: What you can see from this registration where it says "earlier registrations" is that all the people there at one time lived at Taubergasse 15.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Turning to page 4 of the German version --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I do not have 4. Then I have this (indicates). My registration report stops at page 3.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KARIBI-WHYTE
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. O'SULLIVAN
utterances.text: Is there a page missing? It is a four page document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KARIBI-WHYTE
utterances.text: There is no page 4 on my document.

utterances.speaker: MR. O'SULLIVAN
utterances.text: There must have been a mistake in the photocopying. This is the fourth page which should be added to that document, your Honours. (Handed).

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: So that is page 4.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes, you can see at the top of page 4 Zejnil Delalic born 25th March 1948?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You will see he is no longer registered as living at Taubergasse 15, door 14 after 20th November 1995, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is what it says here.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: It says he moved to Germany.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I would like to talk to you a little bit about the information you had concerning INDA-Bau prior to the issuance of the warrants for that premises. Before seeking that warrant, the part when your division looked at the public records for the company INDA-Bau to ascertain certain things about the company, did you not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is correct, and we carried out an investigation or several investigations on the spot.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You knew that that company was created in 1984; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I do not really know that. Mr. Moerbaur carried out that investigation, it concerned INDA-Bau. I just went to see if the firm actually existed and people working there. There was some economic matter that was raised concerning INDA-Bau, but I do not really know any more. There was a sign up saying it was INDA-Bau and another sign saying MAS, that is all I know really. That is all I can tell you about INDA-Bau.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: My question for you deals more with your knowledge of the documentation, the public records of the company. The question is this: you knew that Zejnil Delalic was not and had never been a director or shareholder of INDA-Bau, is that not correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I knew that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You knew that no one named Delalic had ever been a director or shareholder of INDA-Bau; is that not so?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I also knew that. Mr. Moerbaur told me that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You knew that Mr. Delalic lived and worked in Munich Germany and not for INDA-Bau Vienna.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I did not know that. I did not know where he was working. I was told by Interpol that Mr. Delalic was residing in Munich. That is all I knew. Whether he was actually there or not, I did not know.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You were in charge of operations concerning the arrest of Mr. Mucic, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You were also in charge of the searches and seizures that occurred in connection with the arrest of Mr. Mucic that took place at Taubergasse 15.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You also did quite a bit of the paperwork in connection with the arrest of Mr. Mucic.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: As well as the paperwork for alleged search and seizures which followed his arrest; that is the searches of Taubergasse 15 and INDA-Bau.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, in conjunction with other officers, that is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Your signature, for instance, appears on the record, the Niederschrift prepared in connection with Taubergasse 15, door 10.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, that is my signature, that is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And your signature appears on the report, the Bericht inventory prepared for door 10 which is dated 22nd April 1996?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, that must be my signature too. There is not only mine though, there must be others.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Your signature also appears on the report, the Bericht, the evaluation prepared for door 10 dated 22nd April 1996.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Not necessarily, but basically I usually sign any piece of paper that is produced by someone working for me. This analysis or evaluation does not only concern the documents, it also relates to the video cassettes and Mr. Moerbaur, Mr. Bycek and myself worked on that, so I imagine three signatures ought to appear there. There are three names and three signatures.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I am not suggesting there are other signatures or not on the document, I am just saying that your signature is on it; do you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I would suppose so.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: With regard to INDA-Bau, your signature appears on the report, the inventory, dated 22nd April 1996.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: With regard to INDA-Bau, no, that would not be me, Navrat was working with that. I was at Taubergasse 15 and Officer Navrat was at Koupstrasse 40.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You are saying that on the report, the inventory for INDA-Bau dated April 26th 1996 you did not sign that document?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: We are talking about different things here. I am referring to the report that was drawn up on the 18th by Mr. Navrat. I am not sure which document you are referring to.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I will repeat my question. The date of the document is April 22nd 1996. It is a report, an inventory prepared in connection with INDA-Bau. Your signature is on that document, is it not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This is after the analysis had been carried out by our group, so yes, my signature would be on that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That is all I am asking. Your signature also appears on the report, the evaluation prepared for INDA-Bau which is also dated April 22nd 1996?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I would assume so.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You are not sure if you signed that document?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The analysis report concerns the documents and the video tapes and since I was working with the video tapes, I take it my signature would be on there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: With regard to Taubergasse 15, door 14, you signed the report, the inventory dated April 22nd 1996.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Still in regards to door 14, you signed the report, the evaluation dated April 22nd 1996.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Just a couple more questions about documents. You signed the search of the BH club at Taubergasse 15; you signed the record, the Niederschrift of that alleged search.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I was down there with Bycek for a short time and with Dzemal Delalic and then I went back upstairs to Mucic's apartment. I was at various places in the course of the search on 18th March.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And you signed the Niederschrift for that BH club.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I really do not know, I might well have but I really do not know. Were you to show me the document then I could tell you whether I have signed it or not.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Still in keeping with the BH club, did you sign the report, the house search prepared in connection with those premises?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Mr. Bycek wrote that report because he was executing that search and I do believe that I signed that document, yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Finally, you also signed the report April 24th 1996 the final report prepared in connection with all these searches and seizures, did you not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I did sign that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At Taubergasse 15, four premises were searched, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Three places, door 10, Mucic's apartment, door 14, the apartment of Zejnil Delalic and then on the ground floor the premises of the BiH club which was also used by the MAS company.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So those are the only three searches at Taubergasse 15, is that what you are saying?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Aside from you, there were several other police officers at Taubergasse 15 that day, March 18th 1996.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Taubergasse 15, besides Borlak, Moerbaur, Bycek and myself, there were two other officers, Unger and Vinkelmann. They were in the apartment of Mr. Delalic and Mr. Vinter and another officer, they were carrying out a search at MAS in a house nearby.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: His name was Theringer?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, thank you.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Were there any other police officers at Taubergasse 15 that day?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: We did not know how things were going to develop, but otherwise I cannot remember; Tott, Graznek were at Taubergasse 15 briefly in Mr. Dzemal Delalic's apartment, they searched there, so they were there briefly as well.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So aside from yourself and the seven police officers we have named, how many police officers were there that day at Taubergasse 15? You have just named one; could you repeat his name?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: In the building as a whole? On that day, if you take the time between 2.15 pm and, say, 5.00 pm, somewhere around that, I do not know when we left, maybe it was closer to 4.00, but take everybody who was there at one time or another, Mr. Borlak, Mr. Bycek, Mr. Moerbaur, Mr. Vinter, Mr. Theringer, Mr. Unger, Mr. Vinkelmann, Mr. Tott, Mr. Graznek and myself.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Who conducted the alleged search and seizure of the MAS company?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That was Taubergasse 28, is that right? Is that what you are referring to?

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Mr. Vinter and Mr. Theringer.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Who conducted the search and seizure at the BH club?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: In the BiH club there was a search but nothing was seized. Mr. Bycek was in charge, I was down there at certain periods of time and Mr. Dzemal Delalic was present there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: No other police officer was present?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Perhaps Mr. Moerbaur was down there briefly. After Mr. -- rather since Mr. Moerbaur was the one most familiar with the case, he was the one who knew what was most relevant and that is why he was in Mucic's apartment at door 10, he was in Mr. Zejnil Delalic's apartment in door 14 upstairs and he was also at one or other point in time downstairs at the BiH club as well.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. Who conducted the search at door 10?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Mr. Borlak, Mr. Moerbaur, Mr. Bycek and myself were there initially.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Who conducted the search of door 14?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Door 14, Mr. Unger and Mr. Vinkelmann. I was up there when they had some questions and then Mr. Moerbaur was up there occasionally as well.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So I take it you were involved in the planning and execution of this operation at Taubergasse 15?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: It is fair to say that this was a well manned, well prepared operation?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I cannot really judge that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You cannot judge that based on your experience as a police officer, that it was well manned and well prepared?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It is not for me to pass judgments. That is something for my superiors. I think that we had sufficient manpower there, for each search we had two officers on the scene.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You were at Taubergasse 15 for close to three hours in total, give or take; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I cannot say precisely, I just know that with regard to Mucic's apartment, we started at 2.20 pm and we finished with the record at 3.40 pm.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: But in total, you were at the premises, Taubergasse 15, not searching the whole time, but in total about two and a half or three hours.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It did not last that long. I cannot say exactly when we left, but we should have been back at police headquarters by 5.00 pm at the latest.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: How long does it take to drive from Taubergasse 15 to police headquarters?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Depending on traffic, it can vary. We drove in in the afternoon, rush hour in other words, so it would take about 15 or 20 minutes, something along those lines. Let us say rather 20 minutes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That is about three hours in total you were at Taubergasse 15, is that not right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: If you take 2.20 in the afternoon, you add 20, that is 2.40, if I say I was back at the police headquarters before 5.00, as I calculate, that totals up to 2 hours and 20 minutes, not three hours. I said, I really cannot say precisely when we were there, when we left.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Given the number of people, police officers with you and the time you had, it is fair to say things went smoothly and there was no pressure on you to hurry your operations; would you agree with that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: One could agree with that, yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did all four of the searches we have been talking about begin at the same time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: On the whole there were six searches. With regard to when they began, the searches at Taubergasse 15 began pretty much at the same time because there were three localities there, then right next door the MAS company at Taubergasse 28 and the search at the INDA-Bau company, that started a bit later, because Mr. Navrat and two officers from the 16th District police station carried out that search, and those officers were borrowed, as it were. With regard to the Koupstrasse and the Hasnastrasse, that is where Mr. Delalic lives, I could not really tell you when those searches got underway.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What you are saying, if I understand you correctly, is that door 10, door 14 and the BiH club, those searches all started at about the same time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: In the building there at Taubergasse 15, yes, it is fair to say that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Could you tell us how long the search of the BiH club lasted?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I could not say, I do not know.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You were present, were you not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I was present occasionally, and occasionally I was also upstairs in the apartment at door 14. Most of the time I was in Mr. Mucic's apartment.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You said that the daughter of Mr. Mucic, Sanda Mucic, was present at Taubergasse 15 that day.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: She arrived home after Mr. Mucic had been arrested.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: As best as I can remember, practically right after we entered Mr. Mucic's apartment, she came in.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I realise it has been a while and as you have just told us, you do not recollect everything about the BH search. Might I remind you that, and would you agree with me, that on that day, Sanda Mucic had been at work, she had been to the dentist's and she arrived home at about 15.30; do you recall that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That may well be. I do not know. The fact of the matter is that she was in the apartment very shortly after we entered it with Mr. Mucic. Whether she was at the neighbour's or whether she was at the dentist's, I really cannot say.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Do you recall her showing up at approximately 15.30 that day? Does that sound right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: 3.15 -- could you please repeat the question.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I said, does it sound right when I say that she arrived at the premises, Taubergasse 15, you saw her for the first time at approximately 15.30 on that day?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, that is not right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What time did you say she arrived?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: The arrest took place at 2.15 pm. About five minutes later we were in the apartment and a few minutes after that Sanda turned up.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: But do you recall her being at work and being at the dentist, do you not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I do not remember that, no.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You knew that Sanda Mucic was only 16 years old, did you not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, I did not. I knew she was a young girl, but I did not know her precise age.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: When she arrived, you did not ask for her identification to identify her?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, I did not. She introduced herself as Sanda Mucic and on Wednesday or Thursday of the previous week, she had called her father over and as I saw it, on that basis it was perfectly clear that she was the daughter, he was the father.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Based on the information we just looked at in the document that was marked D62/1, we saw there she was born in 1979 which makes her 16 years old in March 1996, does it not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, that is what it says here, but I was not aware of that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: But your colleagues who were with you were aware of this document, were they not?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I do not know. With regard to the Mucic case file, Mr. Moerbaur and myself had most of the information. The others were helping out, as it were. Mr. Bycek was acquainted with the case to a certain extent as well.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So both Bycek and Moerbaur knew that Sanda Mucic was only 16 years old; is that not correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I do not know whether they knew that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At the conclusion of the events that day at Taubergasse 15, did you not get involved in the welfare of Sanda Mucic, knowing that she was a minor, and requesting that either she be turned over to child care services or put in the custody of another adult?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: As far as I know, there was some talk with Hariso Delalic. She was told that her father was being taken along, we did not know for how long. She said she would look after the daughter and the son and I talked to Mr. Dzemal Delalic, who also said that he would be looking after the daughter and the son. Any reference to the social services or whatever of the city of Vienna was not required.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The reason that was done regarding Sanda Mucic was because everyone knew she was 16 years old, right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I did not know that she was only 16.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: With the assistance of the usher, I would like to show a document to the witness, please. There is a copy for the witness, the Prosecution and your Honours. (Handed). There is an English translation followed by the German. What you are looking at is a report prepared and signed by your colleagues Bycek and Moerbaur, dated 14th March 1996. The second paragraph says: "In so doing, it was ascertained that Zdravko Mucic resides along with his son Zoran, born on 23rd May 1977 in Konjic BH, and his daughter Sanda, born 27th April 1979." I will stop there. It is clear that your colleagues Bycek and Moerbaur who were with you in number 10 knew that Sanda was only 16 years old based on this document, would you not agree?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. O'SULLIVAN
utterances.text: Mr. Registrar, what is the number of this document?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: It is document D63/1.

utterances.speaker: MR. O'SULLIVAN
utterances.text: I move to have this document admitted, your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KARIBI-WHYTE
utterances.text: Any objections?

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: I have never seen it before, your Honour. If I might have a minute to look at it?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KARIBI-WHYTE
utterances.text: There is nothing to object to.

utterances.speaker: MR. O'SULLIVAN
utterances.text: I believe it is from the file provided to us by the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: I have no objection, your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. O'SULLIVAN
utterances.text: It is correct, going back to Sanda, that she translated the arrest warrant into German for her father because he did not understand German very well, did he?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Mr. Mucic speaks and understands German. I mentioned that earlier when I was talking to the Prosecutor, but I did ask when we were in Mr. Mucic's apartment, I did ask his daughter to be so kind as to translate the search warrant and the arrest warrant into Yugoslavian, that is to say into her father's mother tongue, and I wanted to be sure to preclude any problems in future, so that is why that was done.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I take it you do not speak or understand Mr. Mucic's mother tongue?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Is it also not the case that Sanda Mucic acted as interpreter between the police officers and her father, more than just translating documents?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, that is not right. I simply asked her to translate that and the rest was said by myself or by fellow officers directly to Mr. Mucic. Perhaps one question or other went through the daughter, but otherwise everything else was spoken in German to Mr. Mucic, with Mr. Mucic I should say.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: But she did interpret certain things, is that not what you just said?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: She interpreted for me the search warrant and the arrest warrant.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Did you not just say she interpreted some of the conversation between you and Mr. Mucic?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I never said that.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At door 10, there were allegedly documents seized; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: There was notebooks, sheets that were seized, yes, that is right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: None of these documents were marked before being taken away, were they?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Not with these stickers, that is right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: They were not marked in any way, were they?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You said that you allegedly seized some videos from door 10 and they were not marked in any way before being taken away?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, that is right. They were not marked there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I believe you told us this morning that you put these items into plastic bags to take back to police headquarters; is that right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: These seized items found in Mr. Mucic's apartment were put into plastic bags and then taken via a motor vehicle to the police headquarters.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: These plastic bags were not marked in any way before leaving the premises, were they?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Not there, no.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And they were not sealed in any way, were they?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: They were not sealed, no.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I have a few questions about door 14. You told us that that search was allegedly carried out by your colleagues Unger and Vinkelmann?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, that is right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I believe earlier you said your signature appears on two reports dated April 22nd 1996 in connection with door 14; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Among the items that were allegedly seized were some documents from door 14, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Door 14 seizure occurred through officers Unger and Vinkelmann.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: My question was: they allegedly took some documents from that premises, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: There is one folder that was seized containing various documents. As to exactly which documents they were, I cannot really say.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I was only asking you whether there were documents. So there were documents and they were not in any way marked before leaving door 14, were they?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is right.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: There were also videos from that apartment which were taken away and not marked before being taken away; is that right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is also correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: They were taken back to police headquarters in a container which was not marked, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: All the seized items in this apartment, Mr. Delalic's apartment, were put in a sports bag. We also put the report, the papers from the seizure in there as well, the 150.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That bag was not marked before leaving the premises?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, it just stayed in the premises. I asked Mr. Dzemal if we could take it, he said "yes, sir", and we took the bag with the things in it.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: When you left the premises you had not put a police mark on the bag; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, there was no police mark.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: And the bag was not sealed in any way, was it?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, it was not sealed. It was sealed in the court, not before. It can only be sealed on the request of the person concerned.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Let us turn to INDA-Bau for a second where again you have prepared reports, I think you have confirmed that, two reports on April 22nd 1996. Do you recall saying that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: These reports on 22nd April, they are reports concerning the seizure where we produced a categorisation. It says in the report an inventory of the items seized from door 15, 14 and INDA-Bau and it says in this report of 22nd April, there is an analysis of those seized items, Mr. Moerbaur wrote that and signed the reports.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: But your signature also appears on the two reports of April 22nd 1996?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The documents which were allegedly taken from INDA-Bau were not marked before leaving the premises, were they?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Counsel, I have -- I took no documents from the INDA-Bau firm.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: That is correct, but to your knowledge, nothing was marked before leaving?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I do not know. That was Mr. Navrat who did that. Then back in the office he gave me all the seized items from INDA-Bau.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Okay. And the videos that he allegedly seized, they left without being marked as well, correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Marking of all seized items during a search -- there are only three, that was what I did on the 18th, maybe in the afternoon or maybe on the next morning, on the morning of the next day.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You say that back at police headquarters, Navrat handed you the items he allegedly took from INDA-Bau; is that right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Navrat came out of his office into mine and had the twelve folders in a cardboard box with the video cassettes and the seizure report, document 150, put it on the table. We were all in the room there with Mr. Mucic, Moerbaur, Bycek, Mr. Borlak and he put it on the middle of the table and gave it to us in that way.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Everything was inside the cardboard box?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: He gave me twelve folders and a cardboard box with videos.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: With the folders in the cardboard box?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, they were put in a box later.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So they were brought in loose, he was carrying the folders loosely and he had a cardboard box as well?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I think he had a number of plastic bags.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: None of the containers were marked or sealed, were they?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: On 18th March, you said you returned to police headquarters after leaving Taubergasse 15; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: On the 18th, Monday 18th March, after the arrest, after the house search, we went directly in a police car from Taubergasse to the police headquarters into the internal courtyard.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What time did you arrive at headquarters?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I am not sure. I cannot say exactly. Around 5.00, a bit before 5.00.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What time did you leave headquarters that day?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It was on the next day.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: At what time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It was probably around 1.30, so it was on Tuesday 19th, 1.30, around that time I left headquarters and then I went back home, about 2.30.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: When we say 1.30 we mean 1.30 am, an hour and a half after midnight, just for clarification.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is correct, in the night from Monday to Tuesday 19th, 1.30 am.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You say you were in room 331; is that correct, at police headquarters?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is my office.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What are the approximate dimensions of that room generally, approximately?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: There are four people in it, around 40, probably, square metres.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: Who were the four people that use that room?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Mr. Bycek, Mr. Moerbaur, at the time the officer who was working on it, Mr. Herman and myself, but he was not there at the time, he was being sent to the Interior Ministry.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: This is your regular office; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, that is my office, my and my staff's office, my colleagues' office.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: What kind of furniture is there in this room?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Various desks, chairs and a cabinet.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: So it is one desk -- four desks, one desk per person?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: No, there are several others. It was actually designed for more people, there are seven or eight desks but only four people in there.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: You told us this morning that all the allegedly seized items from the three locations, door 10, 14, and INDA-Bau, were put into a cabinet in room 331; is that right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That is correct.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: If I heard you correctly, you said that only Bycek, Moerbaur and yourself had access to this cabinet?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, only the three of us had access to that cabinet.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: The only people who had access to room 331 were you, Moerbaur, Bycek and your fourth colleague, Hiermann, I believe you said?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, only the four of us, but other people do come in for an interview or a superior comes in. It is an office, you know.

utterances.speaker: UNKNOWN EXAMINER
utterances.text: I am thinking of the evening of 18th March. The only three people who had access to this room were you, Bycek and Moerbaur, is that right?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: On the 18th, in that room, for the most part, until the prisoner was handed over, the lady who was interpreting, Ms. Supert; Mr. Borlak; Mr. Moerbaur; Mr. Bycek; myself; Mr. Gschwendt, my superior on this case; Magister Famler, who was the legal adviser from the department; Mr. Navrat, who came in to give me the items. I think Mr. Unger and Mr. Vinkelmann were in the next office writing a summary report. As I remember, those were the people.

utterances.speaker: MR. O'SULLIVAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, perhaps this may be a good time to break?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE KARIBI-WHYTE
utterances.text: I think you can stop now. We will continue at 11.00 am tomorrow. We are enjoying your cross-examination. (5.30 pm) (Court adjourned until 11.00 am the following day) 19 20 21 22 23 24 25
